v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given day with events, when slots are suggested, then non conflicting times are suggested

v2_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given day Friday, when meeting start times are available, then 15:00 is the last start time.

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_1: Starting time plus duration exceeding 17:00 will not be seen
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_2: Starting time plus duration conflicting with reserved meeting will not be seen
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_3: Given existing events, times conflicting will not be available
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_4: Past times will not be suggested
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_5: Past days will not be suggested
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_6: Meeting times on Friday cannot start past 15:00

v2_human_g2_goal: This application allows users to book meetings from 9:00 to 17:00 on Mon-Thur and 9:00-15:00 on Friday. Users can display event aware conflicting or invalid times will not show on the software.
v2_human_g2_input:
Events - Describing conflicting timed events, takes in a List of dictionary of two consecutive strings "9:00" or "17:00" type of inputs.
Meeting_number - input & integer, describes # of min.
Day - String of 3 char, shows string of day
v2_human_g2_output: Returns list of valid start times in ascending order
